purpose: Visual concept review only. Fictional sample data; not implementation, test, permission, or production evidence.

entries.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one coherent 2×2 sheet of FOUR DIFFERENT, high-fidelity Menoteam developer-team application screens. This is sheet 1 of 4, containing views 01–04. All 16 views will appear on ONE scrolling review page. These must look like useful daily development software, with substantive data tables, selection, filters, breadcrumbs, detail panes and clear actions, not four simplistic landing pages or title cards. Flat desktop screenshots, landscape sheet, largest available resolution, full screenshots visible. Small unobtrusive panel headings. No computer devices or perspective.

REPLACEMENT DESIGN WORLD: professional neutral operational UI. White main panels, cool light slate sidebar/background, fine #DDE1E7 dividers, dark charcoal text, restrained indigo selected/action color, conventional semantic green/amber/red states. Compact Inter/Noto Sans SC, fixed modest headings, 12–14px-like data type, 28–36px-like row rhythm, familiar shadcn/ui and Tailwind-feasible controls. NO forest, botanical art, grain, oversized whitespace, scenic illustration, hero headings, glass or gradients. Same sober application shell in all four screens: Menoteam wordmark; compact workspace/project selector; search box “搜索… ⌘K”; project navigation “Work”, “Work Map”, “Agents”, “Quality”, “Releases”, “Settings”. Global “Overview”, “Profiles”, “Recovery” are separate compact shell links, not sixteen sidebar entries. Selected nav visibly corresponds to each screen. Fictional data; consistency across sheets: project Field Notes, work FN-42 “修复重复保存”, Slack #field-notes, PR #42.

TOP LEFT heading “01 多项目总览”.
Compact page title “Overview”. Toolbar filters “全部项目”, “我的”, “团队”, plus “连接项目”. A substantive project table: columns “项目 / Master / 活跃工作 / 当前阶段 / 最近同步”. Rows Field Notes (实现中), Menoteam (需审核), Safe Driver (QA 中). Show worker initials beside the appropriate project, source/connection freshness, not invented ROI metrics. Below, a slim work table “需要处理”: FN-51 “权限边界变更” / “团队规则需审核”; FN-43 “浏览器工具离线” / “QA 受阻”. A side pane or compact lower section lists a few recent deliveries and activity timestamps. No approvals for the normal small-change FN-42. Professional scan density.

TOP RIGHT heading “02 项目接入”.
Title “连接项目”, GitHub/local directory segmented choice. Repo “example/field-notes”, clone status, checkout “~/Projects/field-notes”. Existing “Slack · #field-notes · 已连接”. One “项目目标” natural-language input. Master repo scan summary showing README, AGENTS, CI, skills. A concise readiness table for “Git / Checks / Browser / App / Computer” with actual probe-like ready/pending labels. Suggested rules summarized as required tests+lint+independent QA; small changes automatic merge/deploy, major changes rule-based review. One primary “确认并开始”, secondary “编辑建议”. Do not make a sprawling form or treat URL-only as connected.

BOTTOM LEFT heading “03 项目工作区”.
Breadcrumb “Field Notes / Work”. Title “Work”. Toolbar “列表 / Board”, status/source/owner filters, “提出工作”. Main substantial work table with rows FN-42 duplicate save, FN-43 export regression, FN-44 API retry, FN-45 deployment check; status, owner and source columns, FN-42 selected. Compact right pane “Master” with persistent project goal, two concise conversation turns, and current plan: reproduce → parallel implementation → independent QA. Source includes Slack; one input “继续这个项目…” and send. Small top status “Autopilot 运行中”, pause menu rather than a giant button. Context and work are connected; not a chat page with no work.

BOTTOM RIGHT heading “04 Work Map”.
Breadcrumb Field Notes / Work Map, toolbar “Graph / List”, filters, search. Main dependency view with left-to-right lanes “Goals / Work / Agents / Evidence”; around eight concise linked nodes, not a decorative network: goal “可靠保存”, work “FN-42”, two workers “客户端” and “API”, integration owner, independent QA, PR #42 and browser evidence. Use thin clean connectors with NO arrowheads to avoid reverse flow confusion. Selected FN-42 has a narrow right details pane containing goal/scope, owner “Master”, source Slack, required gate, next step, and “打开详情”. Show dependency/ownership/evidence, not just two agent boxes.
No decorative illustrations, empty metric tiles, invented sprints/billing/cloud backend or oversized welcome text. Each view must visibly contain its actual daily-use content and actions. Exactly four panels on this sheet, with crisp concise Chinese mixed English labels.

Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the attached professional Menoteam 2×2 UI sheet into sheet 2 of the SAME 16-view prototype. Retain the exact neutral slate/white/indigo design system, compact typography, detailed desktop layout, top search, Menoteam logo and consistent sidebar. Completely REPLACE the four content areas and their panel labels with views 05–08 below. No forest/artwork or oversized empty space. Exactly four complete screenshots, largest available resolution. Content must be legible concise Chinese mixed English, functionally substantial and shadcn/Tailwind-feasible. All sample data is fictional.

TOP LEFT “05 工作详情”.
Breadcrumb “Field Notes / Work / FN-42”. Title “修复重复保存”, status “实现中”, metadata source “Slack · #field-notes”, owner Master, small-change project rule. Practical tab row “概况 / Changes / Evidence / Activity”.
Main area shows selected “Changes”: PR #42, branch “work/FN-42”, a short two-file change list “SaveButton.tsx”, “notes.ts”, and a tidy selected-file code diff with a few plus/minus lines. Right context panel contains request, reproduction, integration owner, dependency, and next step “等待独立 QA”. Below a chronological work activity with investigation, assigned two workers, changes integrated. A compact follow-up comment input; “在 Codex 打开” link. This is one durable work record linking source/change/evidence, not just a green checklist.

TOP RIGHT “06 Agents / Run Inspector”.
Breadcrumb Field Notes / Agents. Toolbar role/status filters and resource availability. Main agent table with substantive rows “Master”, “Worker A”, “Worker B”, “Verifier”, “Skill Observer”; columns role, work, state, assigned profile, checkout. Worker A selected; both A and B visibly executing in parallel, verifier waiting for integrated revision. Right “Run Inspector” pane with run ID “run-42-a”, model “Luna”, profile “Codex A”, isolated checkout, recent concrete tool events: read file → apply patch → check result. Tabs “Events / Logs / Changes”. Show current event and compact structured result; actions “暂停此 run”, “查看 work”. Tool success is not labelled QA passed. Do not draw independent new VMs for every agent.

BOTTOM LEFT “07 本地资源与工具”.
Field Notes / Settings / Resources. Top compact local host “Local Mac · 在线” and “重新检查” action. One environment/toolchain row shared by multiple workers, plus separate checkout rows. Main resource table with columns “资源 / 状态 / 占用者 / 影响工作”: project toolchain ready; port reserved by Worker A; database assigned to Worker B; Browser busy with Verifier; Computer idle; App probe failed blocking FN-43. Make shared-resource use and code isolation clear. A selected resource side panel shows owner, scope, last probe, and queued dependent work. Small warning for the required App tool with “重新 probe”; do not imply force releasing a live owner's resource is safe. No cloud infrastructure, secret keys, container-per-agent pattern or invented billing charts.

BOTTOM RIGHT “08 Quality / Evidence”.
Field Notes / Quality. Select work FN-42, integrated revision “a71c2d4”, rules “v3”, environment Local Mac. Required-checks matrix with rows “Tests”, “Lint”, “Integration”, “独立 Browser QA”; status, verifier and evidence columns. First checks pass, Browser QA fails. Clear header “QA 未通过” and affected release gated, not “Delivered”. A real evidence pane mockup includes a compact browser screenshot of a notes app visibly showing two duplicate records after saving, with timestamp/source and a short failure observation. Tabs or secondary evidence entries “Browser / App / Computer / Logs”, plus a stale evidence example labelled “旧版本证据已失效”. Action “修复并重跑”. Evidence is bound to revision/rules/environment; no human Accept button for this small change, no treating code exit 0 as complete QA.

Keep the original coherent product shell. Select matching sidebar Work, Agents, Settings and Quality for the respective panels. Retain sensible dense tables, filters, selected rows and contextual details. No simple card grid replacing real operational content. These four screenshots are different from sheet 1.

Edit this existing four-screen Menoteam prototype sheet, preserving the same crisp neutral shadcn/ui visual system and 2x2 layout. The key correction is INFORMATION HIERARCHY: this is an agent collaboration workbench, not a log-monitoring platform. Default UI should show goal, progress, blocker, next action, result, and a direct way to ask the responsible agent. Actual evidence stays accessible; raw logs are only on demand. No permanently visible terminal, raw event stream, JSON, or large logs panel.

TOP RIGHT V06: REPLACE its Run Inspector / event timeline with an Agent Detail / conversation panel. External caption "V06 Agents · Agent Detail". Keep a compact useful agent roster (Master / Worker A / Worker B / Verifier / Skill Observer; each has current work, status, local environment, profile and model). Select Worker A with work FN-42 修复重复保存. Right pane prominently shows "负责 FN-42", "正在做：修复重复请求", "进展：修改完成，等待独立 QA", "阻塞：无", "下一步：交给 Verifier". Then a real short contextual conversation with Worker A: user "这次为什么会重复保存？" agent "连续点击触发了两次请求。我已添加请求锁，下一步验证双击只生成一条记录。" links "查看改动" and "查看 QA". Input "问 Worker A…" and send control. Small footer detail / 查看执行记录 affordance, collapsed and secondary. Buttons message/resume/pause only where state permits. No chronological run event rows. gpt-6-luna for routine work and gpt-6.1-sol for Master/harder work are permitted example settings, fictional data.

TOP LEFT V05 Work Detail: keep a concrete work detail about FN-42 with source Slack #field-notes, GitHub PR #42, relevant diff and reproduction, integration owner, meaningful result/next step. Add/keep concise "问 Master" / "问负责 Agent" action. If original has an activity stream, replace raw events with a concise three-row summary of meaningful decisions/results. Diff and evidence need not disappear; do not let logs become central.

BOTTOM LEFT V07 Local Resources & Tools: preserve the useful shared port/database/browser/desktop resource coordination table and ownership/readiness. Reduce any verbose tool output to clear Ready / Busy / Permission needed with actionable next step and "问 Master". No raw logs. Keep shared resources coordination visible because parallel local workers must avoid conflicts.

BOTTOM RIGHT V08 Quality & Evidence: preserve the independent browser QA failure view, required Tests/Lint/Integration passed and Browser QA failed, concrete duplicate-save failure evidence with linked screenshot/PR revision/rules version, stale prior evidence marked stale, and 修复并重测 action. This is actual validation evidence, not a logs feed. Include "问 Verifier" contextual action, focus conclusion 原因 / 影响 / 下一步. Avoid hiding failures behind agent reassurance.

Use compact readable Chinese mixed with English, relative times only, no absolute dates. Four distinctly useful screens, captions V05–V08. Keep sample data fictional. Do not add decorative art, analytics, or another view. Output ONE landscape image.

Create a high-fidelity product design review sheet for Menoteam, a mature local-first multi-project agent workbench used daily by developers. Use the attached sheet ONLY as a reference for the same neutral shadcn/ui + Tailwind visual system, desktop shell, typography, spacing, and component language. REPLACE ALL FOUR SCREEN CONTENTS. This is sheet 3 of 4. A clean 2 by 2 grid of four distinct full desktop application screens on one landscape canvas, each framed separately with a small crisp caption V09 / V10 / V11 / V12 outside the screen. Crisp readable UI, realistic operational density, no decorative art, no forests, no gigantic hero titles, no marketing prose. Light slate-white surfaces, charcoal text, thin borders, subtle indigo selected states, semantic status chips. Compact Chinese mixed with English text. Use relative timestamps, never absolute dates. Shared top bar Menoteam / Field Notes and a narrow left sidebar with Work, Work Map, Agents, Quality, Releases, Settings. Each screen should have its own distinctive full content area and contextual details. Fictional data only.

TOP LEFT V09 Releases. Selected sidebar Releases. A practical release dashboard with project and environment filters and a release table: FN-42 修复重复保存, PR #42, staging/production, commit a81f2c9, Delivered; FN-44 搜索筛选, Post-check failed, recovery action. Below selected FN-42, a horizontal clear gate timeline: Tests + Lint + Integration + independent Browser QA passed > Merge completed > Deploy completed > Post-deploy verification passed. A concise evidence detail pane shows required checks passed, revision a81f2c9, rules v3, production smoke test passed, release receipt, artifact/source links. Mark Delivered only after post-deploy verification. Small qualified change went through autopilot without a manual approve step. Failed release has evidence and actionable recover/rollback when permitted. Buttons 查看证据, 打开部署, 恢复. Do not imply all changes require human approval.

TOP RIGHT V10 Reviews. Work exception queue for major changes, selected row FN-51 调整项目权限, Needs review, rule 项目权限变更, requested action Apply permission migration. List other waiting review items compactly. A large concrete review pane shows trigger and allowed review scope, proposed plan, impact 3 roles / 2 API routes, migration and rollback steps, file diff excerpt, QA evidence revision, risk details. The execution has paused only at the restricted permission change; other parallel tasks continue. Buttons 请求修改 and 批准此变更. No vague approve-everything button, no daily routine code review bottleneck. Clear current rule version and specific requested action.

BOTTOM LEFT V11 Project Rules. Settings / Rules. A readable plain-language rule editor with version v3 and sections: Scope & goal; Allowed autopilot changes; Human review required for permission changes, destructive schema changes and large scope; Required gates tests, lint, integration, independent browser QA; delivery target production and post-deploy smoke checks. Rule summary on the side shows current checks and enforcement coverage with all required checks on. Rule changes produce a new version and stale earlier evidence must be rerun. Buttons 保存新版本 and 查看变更. Compact rules, human readable, no generic workflow DSL, no giant flowchart builder.

BOTTOM RIGHT V12 Skills. Settings / Skills. Skills library table with scope Project / Personal / Team, version, last evaluation, usage and concise function. Selected observer proposal: 防止重复保存, evidence 2 prior failures linked to FN-42 and FN-31. A right-pane proposal review with small before/after diff adding double-click reproduction and browser assertions, a concise evaluation result Passed 4 scenarios, optional editable instruction text, scope Project, buttons 编辑, 采用, 忽略. The observer only proposes and the user deliberately adopts; no silent global changes or automatic project rule replacement. Show link to source conversations and failed runs, limited project access.

All four views must be practical detailed desktop layouts with tables, meaningful actions, evidence, and contextual panes. No duplicate screen layouts or placeholder cards. Make all sixteen feature views conceptually coherent with the reference but these are specifically delivery, exception review, project rules, and skill learning. Output ONE landscape image.

Create a high-fidelity Menoteam product prototype review sheet, sheet 4 of 4, matching the attached reference's neutral shadcn/ui + Tailwind desktop application shell and component language. Replace ALL FOUR reference screen contents with the following new views. ONE landscape canvas with four distinct full desktop screens in a clean 2x2 grid, small external captions V13 / V14 / V15 / V16. Compact readable Chinese mixed with English. Fictional sample data only. No decorative art, no forest theme, no hero headlines, no marketing text, no absolute dates. Use relative timestamps. Light slate-white panels, charcoal text, thin borders, restrained indigo actions. Mature means useful state and actions, NOT exposing raw logs. Show no terminal output, no JSON event stream, no constantly scrolling logs. Shared top bar Menoteam / Field Notes; narrow six-item sidebar Work, Work Map, Agents, Quality, Releases, Settings.

TOP LEFT V13 Members & Access, Settings / Members. A full project-level members view for Field Notes. Clearly show Project visibility: Private / Team, current Private with only invited members. Compact members table Name / project role / access / status: Lin Li Owner Active, Mei Developer Active, Sam Viewer Active, Alex Developer Invitation pending. Detail pane for selected member with accessible project and scoped capabilities, remove or change role actions, no shared execution credentials. Useful invite control email/name and role, Invite button, pending invitation with resend/revoke. Small second section Invited projects shows one invitation "Atlas / invited by Mei / Developer" and Join / Decline actions. Explain remote team access through authorized Slack/project connection and a local host online state; do not imply other members can browse localhost from their computers. No admin analytics.

TOP RIGHT V14 Connections, Settings / Connections. GitHub and Slack service connections with owner, status, granted scope and concise reconnect actions. GitHub Connected, repo org/field-notes, clone location local folder, permissions repository read/write and PR access. Slack Connected #field-notes, workspace Mino team, message events routing to Field Notes Master; local connector Online. A routing table channel/repository > project > responsible Master. Selected route detail has latest sync "2分钟前", source links, event deduplication on, authorized scope. Include another route Attention / reconnect needed. Buttons 添加连接 and 重新连接. Project routes, external source identity, and agent-access scope are clear; do not show token/password fields or pretend Slack is itself a web host. Include "问 Master" contextual action for connection issue.

BOTTOM LEFT V15 Execution Profiles, global settings / execution profiles. A concise table of two authorized local Codex configurations with account label, subscription/profile, preferred model, availability: Main / gpt-6-luna / Quota reached, Backup / gpt-6-luna / Ready. Model policy can assign gpt-6.1-sol to difficult work. Authorized configuration switching, not sharing credentials. A selected Backup profile pane with "设为新任务默认" action and note active workers keep their current profile. Compact current assignments: Worker A on Main Paused, Worker B on Backup Running, Master on Backup Ready. A visible Interrupted work FN-42 row links to Recovery. Explain default switch applies new work; interrupted work is explicitly resumed from its checkpoint. No billing dashboard, no invented quota percentages, no passwords, no automatic claim of seamless native thread migration.

BOTTOM RIGHT V16 Recovery. A Work interrupted queue with FN-42 修复重复保存 selected. Right main panel focuses on continuation: latest checkpoint 修复已完成，等待 QA / same work FN-42 and context retained; previous profile Main unavailable; select Backup Ready. A short reconciliation list of previous side effects: PR #42 confirmed, reuse existing PR; deployment outcome Unknown, verify receipt before replay; Slack update confirmed, do not resend. State 验证上一轮部署结果, progress Awaiting check, next step check result then continue remaining required QA/delivery. Prominent button 核对后续做; once safe "切换并续做". Help link 问 Master and small 查看恢复证据, raw records only on demand. Display what is blocked and what can continue, preserve same Work ID, no duplicate PR/deploy/message. If native session resume unavailable, checkpoint recovery remains possible; communicate as one concise state, not runtime internals.

Each view must cover its actual settings/action states with meaningful compact tables and selected details. Make members, integration scope, execution credentials, and recovery clearly separate. These are four distinct feature views, not four decorative dashboards. Output ONE landscape image.
